verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for llms.txt at docs.beglaubigt.de, which indexes the API documentation. The docs also publish an llms-full.txt containing full content such as webhook event descriptions. Separately, beglaubigt.de/llms.txt summarizes the services and the B2B API integration, so an agent can be pointed at either site. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on report of agents actually using these files, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404) to complement the agent-oriented docs.
